project: Yes, the clock that MathPup fetched is showing 4:00

At the top of the screen is information about what Time Balloon MathPup needs to retrieve. To move MathPup use the arrow keys or "WASD" keys on the keyboard or the on-screen touch circle for touch devices.  Have MathPup go to the correct Time Balloon and carry it back to the island.  Once MathPup has landed on the island with the correct time balloon you'll get points added to your score plus any time bonus. Please try hard to get the correct balloon so the monkey doesn't have to throw his banana!
